decisions.reason: This hand-knotted wool silk carpet remains closely aligned with the firm's strongest craftsmanship and premium-material capabilities, so management is likely to keep learning from market feedback and refine its positioning rather than withdraw it.

Although this low-pile decorative carpet still faces some overlap risk after other similar carpets were removed, its survival through the first review suggests the firm sees enough fit with existing know-how and enough scope to improve it to justify keeping it.

The corner bench builds directly on the firm's core furniture, customization and project-business knowledge, giving management high absorptive capacity to interpret demand and adjust the offer instead of dropping it.
